features: THE OCEAN LIFE FANCY WINE STOPPER COMES WITH UNIQUE DESIGN YOU WILL LOVE – Enjoy the rest of your unconsumed wine just as how it tasted before the bottle was opened. The sparkling octopus wine stopper seals out the air and minimizes wine oxidation to extend your wine's life so you can drink the rest without losing the flavor, aroma, & color. This novelty wine charm is part of our sea life barware collection, a great add to your bar accessories.

THE CUTE WINE STOPPER IS FOR WINE ENTHUSIASTS – Perfect gift for wine lovers to keep their favorite blend preserved for days. The practical design with playful craftsmanship will dazzle guests during parties and make excellent decor for any kitchen, dining & bar setting. The metal octopus bottle accessory is packaged in a PVC box for easy gifting! A great giveaway for housewarming parties, weddings & any celebrations that are worthy of a toast!

INCLUDED WITH THE PURCHASE OF DECORATIVE WINE STOPPER - 1 Cheers reusable Silver Octopus Wine Bottle Stopper, a beautifully molded octopus metal figure on top of a chrome base, wrapped with a black rubber liner for a snug fit. Insert the rubber end firmly in the neck of the bottle for an airtight seal. 3-in-1 zinc alloy cork keeps drinks fresh, displays elegance and turns into a conversation piece. The octopus metal wine plug measures 5 inches.

HIGH-QUALITY WINE BOTTLE TOPPER – Octopus rhinestone wine stopper is a stylish reusable elegant wine charm made of premium quality zinc alloy, designed for a leak-proof plug to keep your partially consumed vino tasty fresh for days. A compact, sturdy, and reliable craftsmanship octopus charm with sparkling rhinestones for a fancier look. The air-tight animal bottle sealer is built with food-grade rubber materials, safe, and effective sealer.

IDEAL USE FOR THE OCTOPUS WINE SEALER - Prolong the aroma and taste of your wine with the Silver Octopus Rhinestone Bottle Stopper! Extend the storage time of the beverage with a decorative sealer for an eye-catching display on your wine rack and bar counter. Novelty wine bottle stoppers fit any bar accessory collection to celebrate any occasion! Perfect for hosting events, holidays, housewarmings, weddings, party favors and stocking stuffers.
